title: 第177章，弄不死你，我便不姓李！
slug: 满级小李飞刀我在水浒当判官
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“谁？”

对方说完，李逸一时竟没反应过来。

迟疑半响，他才疑惑开口:

“阁下就是秦会之？”

会之，正是秦桧表字。

“知州大人亦知道我？”

秦桧闻言，心中却是一喜。

但见韩炜伸两只手掌，这中山然还真就在两掌之内来去自如的翩翩起舞。

他想要逃离，但是无用，已经被神火给点燃，最终化为黑灰，魂归不周山。

二人一同下了城墙，没一会，一同出城，二人都是用枪，一左一右，齐头并进，向成闵压来。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Who?"

After the other party finished speaking, Li Yi didn't react for a moment.

After hesitating for a while, he said in confusion:

"You are Qin Huizhi?"

It turns out that it is Qin Hui's cousin.

"Master Zhizhou also knows about me?"

When Qin Hui heard this, he felt happy in his heart.

But when Han Wei stretched out his two palms, Zhongshan Ran was really dancing freely within the two palms.

He wanted to escape, but it was useless. He had been ignited by the divine fire, and finally turned into black ashes, and his soul returned to Buzhou Mountain.

The two of them descended the city wall together, and after a while, they came out of the city together. Both of them used guns, one on the left and one on the right, to press towards Cheng Min.

title_en: Chapter 177: If I can’t kill you, my surname will not be Li!
